exec git init -b main scope-project
cd scope-project
at 2026-07-15T12:00:00Z
exec card init --prefix scope- --board-name 'Primary board'
exec sh -c 'printf "version: 1\nissue:\n  id:\n    prefix: scope-\n    strategy: sequential\n" > .cardamom/config.yaml'

exec card --board board_00000000000000000000 create --type workstream 'Primary root'
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/primary-root.txt
exec card --board board_00000000000000000000 create 'Primary child'
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/primary-child.txt
exec card edit scope-2 --parent scope-1
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/edited-child.txt

exec card board create 'Secondary board'
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/secondary-board.txt
exec card --board board_11111111111111111111 create 'Secondary issue'
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/secondary-issue.txt

# A whole-board dump contains only the explicitly selected board.
exec card --board board_00000000000000000000 dump primary-dump
cmpenv stdout $WORK/golden/dump-primary.txt
cmp primary-dump/README.md $WORK/golden/primary-README.md
cmp primary-dump/issues/scope-1.md $WORK/golden/primary-root.md
cmp primary-dump/issues/scope-2.md $WORK/golden/primary-child.md
! exists primary-dump/issues/scope-3.md

# Issue selection infers one board and includes containment descendants only.
exec card dump selected-dump --issue scope-1
cmpenv stdout $WORK/golden/dump-selected.txt
cmp selected-dump/issues/scope-1.md $WORK/golden/selected-root.md
cmp selected-dump/issues/scope-2.md $WORK/golden/selected-child.md
! exists selected-dump/README.md
! exists selected-dump/issues/scope-3.md

# A selected dump cannot combine roots from different boards.
! exec card dump mixed-dump --issue scope-1,scope-3
stderr 'issue IDs belong to multiple boards'
! exists mixed-dump

# With multiple boards, apply requires explicit or checkout-selected scope.
! exec card apply $WORK/valid.json
stderr 'board selection is ambiguous'

# Foreign dependencies and containment fail without creating any document issues.
! exec card --board board_00000000000000000000 apply $WORK/foreign-dependency.json
stderr 'issue ID "scope-3" belongs to board "board_11111111111111111111"'
exec card --board board_00000000000000000000 --json list
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/primary-issues.jsonl

! exec card --board board_00000000000000000000 apply $WORK/foreign-containment.json
stderr 'issue ID "scope-3" belongs to board "board_11111111111111111111"'
exec card --board board_00000000000000000000 --json list
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/primary-issues.jsonl

# An explicit board receives every issue from a valid document.
exec card --board board_11111111111111111111 apply $WORK/valid.json
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/apply-secondary.txt
exec card --board board_11111111111111111111 --json list
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/secondary-issues.jsonl
